On 2026-08-12, The New York Times reported “In a social media post, Mr. Trump said that Ms. Leavitt, who recently returned from maternity leave after giving birth to her second child , would leave at the end of the month to spend time with her young children — a decision that he said “I totally understand and respect.””; on 2026-08-13, The New York Times reported “President Trump’s press secretary is stepping down.”.

On 2026-08-12, The New York Times reported “In a social media post, Mr. Trump said that Ms. Leavitt, who recently returned from maternity leave after giving birth to her second child , would leave at the end of the month to spend time with her young children — a decision that he said “I totally understand and respect.””; on the same day, The New York Times reported “Karoline Leavitt, the White House press secretary and one of the most public-facing officials in the Trump administration, will step down to spend more time with her family, she and President Trump announced on Wednesday.”.
